name: Gouda Mayumi
source:
A person who is forced to participate in the game. She is disinterested in cooperating with other players, and with the game in general.

[spoiler]In fact she is one of Game masters — former players, who was hired by game organizers to serve as moles and "spice" the Game from the inside.

Assigned PDA card: 5[/spoiler]
